name: unijack (re-crop 2026-11-12)
perspective: none (board edges measured at +0.36 deg top, -0.42 deg bottom; net tilt 0.03 deg, left as photographed)
mask: pixels connected to the board that are not near-white (any channel below 250), interior holes filled. In the outer 3-pixel band only, pixels that are themselves almost white (every channel 235 or above: the JPEG halo) fade out by how close to white they are; the darkest pixel made partly transparent has a minimum channel value of 236. Everything outside the mask is transparent. Canvas extended with blank margin; no pixels synthesised.
tools: Pillow and NumPy only: crop, mask, canvas margin, Lanczos downscale for the WebP sizes. No generative or AI tools, no upscaling, no retouching.
